vehicle: 2007 Land Rover LR3 (4.4L V8, ZF 6HP26 automatic, air suspension)
disclaimer: Default intervals are conservative owner-community values, often shorter than the factory schedule. Check them against your owner's handbook / Passport to Service and change them to suit how you drive (towing, off-road, short trips). To override, copy this file to ~/.lr3diag/schedule.json and edit it.

items.name: Engine oil & filter
items.notes: Use the grade/spec in the owner's handbook. Shorten the interval for towing or lots of short trips.

items.name: Tire rotation & pressure check
items.notes: Check TPMS sensors and spare at the same time.

items.name: Brake pads/rotors inspection
items.notes: Includes the electronic parking brake (EPB) cable and actuator.

items.name: Air suspension (EAS) inspection
items.notes: Air springs for cracking, lines for leaks, compressor run time/noise, and the dryer. Note ride-height drop after the truck sits overnight.

items.name: Fluid levels & leak check
items.notes: Coolant, power steering, brake, washer. Look for coolant leaks at the crossover pipe/valley.

items.name: Engine air filter
items.notes: Check it more often on dusty trails.

items.name: Brake fluid flush
items.notes: Changed on time rather than mileage, because the fluid absorbs moisture.

items.name: Battery load test
items.notes: The LR3 is very sensitive to low voltage. A weak battery causes odd fault messages (suspension, parking brake, HDC).

items.name: Coolant drain & refill
items.notes: Use the OAT coolant type given in the handbook. Don't mix coolant types.

items.name: Transmission fluid & filter (ZF 6HP26)
items.notes: The factory calls it 'filled for life'. Most specialists recommend changing the fluid, pan and filter every 60k to 70k miles.

items.name: Rear differential oil
items.notes: Locking rear differentials need the correct specified oil.
